mapper.select: SELECT m.session_id AS id, CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END AS peerId, u.nickname AS peerName, u.avatar AS peerAvatar, g.id AS goodsId, g.title AS goodsTitle, g.cover AS goodsCover, m.content AS lastMessage, m.create_time AS lastTime, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message x WHERE x.session_id = m.session_id AND x.to_user_id = #{userId} AND x.is_read = 0) AS unread FROM t_message m INNER JOIN t_user u ON u.id = CASE WHEN m.from_user_id = #{userId} THEN m.to_user_id ELSE m.from_user_id END LEFT JOIN t_goods g ON g.id = CAST(SUBSTRING_INDEX(SUBSTRING_INDEX(m.session_id, '_', 2), '_', -1) AS UNSIGNED) WHERE m.id IN ( SELECT MAX(id) FROM t_message WHERE from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY session_id ) ORDER BY m.create_time DESC
SELECT * FROM t_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND (from_user_id = #{userId} OR to_user_id = #{userId}) ORDER BY create_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_message WHERE to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE t_message SET is_read = 1 WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND to_user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
